String.string:
[EN] Drowned In Blood
[ES] Inundado en sangre
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Nice meeting you."
[ES] "Encantado de conocerte."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll head to Camp Umbra."
[ES] "Iré al Camp Umbra."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Yedwin, Explorer Guild Master of Dragonfall, about the kidnapping.
[ES] Pregúntale a Yedwin, maestro del gremio de exploradores de Dragonfall, sobre el secuestro.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Nighteye Talisman
[ES] Talismán de Ojo Nocturno
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I hear more offerings coming!
[ES] ¡Oigo que se acercan más ofrendas!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] My blood...for Sikander!
[ES] ¡Mi sangre... para Sikander!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] More blood for the altar!
[ES] ¡Más sangre para el altar!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sika-aaaark!
[ES] ¡Sika-aaaark!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Wipe out the mekonari hunters and ebonweavers that are kidnapping people in the Nightwood.
[ES] Aniquila a los cazadores mekonari y a los tejeoscuros que están secuestrando gente en Nightwood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the Nighteye Talisman to Arshak and tell him that you took care of the kidnappers.
[ES] Llévale el talismán de Ojo Nocturno a Arshak y dile que te has ocupado de los secuestradores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Camp Umbra and inform Arshak about the rituals.
[ES] Ve al Camp Umbra e informa a Arshak sobre los rituales.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We'll add your bones to the pile!
[ES] ¡Añadiremos tus huesos al montón!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sikander! Take me!
[ES] ¡Sikander! ¡Llévame!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Volunteering for the ritual? How marvelous!
[ES] ¿Te ofreces como voluntario para el ritual? ¡Qué maravilla!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Too weak... Unworthy...
[ES] Demasiado débil... Indigno...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Search mekonari templars and dedicants for a key to the altar.
[ES] Busca una llave para el altar en los templarios y dedicantes mekonari.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Who's there?"
[ES] "¿Quién está ahí?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Keep searching for the way to the altar.
[ES] Sigue buscando el camino hacia el altar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Can you get me in?"
[ES] "¿Puedes dejarme entrar?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to the ghostly figure.
[ES] Habla con la figura fantasmal.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Follow the spirit to the altar entrance.
[ES] Sigue al espíritu hasta la entrada del altar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the {@linkcreature:256#1501#teleportal} to the Raven Altar Stop the ritual: timed, 16 minutes Destroy the pillar of blood on the Raven Altar and stop the ritual to awaken Sikander.
[ES] Entra en el {@linkcreature:256#1501#teleportal} hacia el Raven Altar Detén el ritual: cronometrado, 16 minutos Destruye el pilar de sangre en el Raven Altar y detén el ritual para despertar a Sikander.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks. I'm on my way!"
[ES] "Gracias. ¡Ya voy!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Arshak.
[ES] Regresa con Arshak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
